''See also: [[King Regent Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Felrex]], also known as King [[Regent]] [[Felrex]] or the King-[[Regent]], is a usurper who seized control of [[Karosha]] from [[Queen Shyrax]]. A member of The Perfected{{!}}the Perfected, he gained power by gathering support against [[the Queen]] and is currently viewed as a blight on the galaxy. His primary ambition involves the expansion of the [[Iron Legion]] through the invasion of the [[Galactic Union]]. To achieve this, he utilizes a specialized group known as The Perfected{{!}}the Perfected and maintains a heavily secured laboratory beneath his royal palace. [[Felrex]] is noted for his strategic patience, often stalling enemies to build his military strength and resources. His rule is characterized by the use of advanced technology and magic, including the deployment of the [[Zenith Cannon]] and the pursuit of creating an [[Iron King]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|King [[Regent]] [[Felrex]] is a monarch who seeks to stall the [[D’Niss]] in order to [[construct]] an army of [[Perfected]]. He is a top leader of The Perfected{{!}}the Perfected and serves as a mutual enemy to both the Captain and [[Solstice]]. His rule is currently being opposed by the [[Rebel Queen]], and he is viewed as a threat by [[Varic Vallenar]] and his crew.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|King [[Regent]] [[Felrex]], the monarch of [[Karosha]], was once a candidate for selection by [[Horizon]]. He is associated with drones observed in the sky and intends to stall the [[D’Niss]] in order to [[construct]] an army of [[Perfected]]. While he watches the duel as a spectator, his position is threatened by [[Varic Vallenar]] and his crew.}}
